findings.quote: Analysis of crude 1 H NMR using internal standard 1,2‐dimethoxyethane
findings.message: The plan omits use of 1,2‐dimethoxyethane as an analytical internal standard. Preserve this as an unmapped analytical operation; its amount and preparation vessel are not stated, so addition to the reactor should not be inferred.

findings.quote: The crude product was purified by silica gel chromatography
findings.message: The purification method records chromatography but omits the explicitly specified silica gel medium.

value.evidence: Analysis of crude 1 H NMR using internal standard 1,2‐dimethoxyethane
